sourceAnnotations.semantic_description: Dark grey matte plastic lower housing forming the base of the laptop, including the bottom shell and side walls.
sourceAnnotations.Basic_description: Dark grey matte plastic lower housing forming the base of the laptop, including the bottom shell and side walls.
sourceAnnotations.Functional_description: Structural enclosure for internal components like the battery, motherboard, and speakers; provides stability when placed on a surface.
sourceAnnotations.Grasped_description: A robot gripper would grasp the front edge or side walls of the base to lift or stabilize the object.

physics.reason: Injection molded plastic laptop chassis are thin-walled shells enclosing air and electronics, not solid blocks.

sourceAnnotations.semantic_description: Dark grey matte plastic upper lid containing the display panel, appearing as a flat rectangular slab when closed.
sourceAnnotations.Basic_description: Dark grey matte plastic upper lid containing the display panel, appearing as a flat rectangular slab when closed.
sourceAnnotations.Functional_description: Protects the LCD screen and houses the webcam; acts as the cover for the device when folded.
sourceAnnotations.Grasped_description: A gripper would pinch the top edge or corner of the lid to open the laptop or lift the closed unit.

physics.reason: Laptop lids are thin sandwich structures (plastic/glass) enclosing the display panel and air gap, not solid material.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
